BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:
SECTION I. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance is hereby amended
by changing all of the B3-2 Community Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map No.
20-E in the area bounded by
A line 249.95 feet North of and parallel to West 84" Street; the public alley next East of and parallel
to South Martin Luther King Drive; a line 199.95 feet North of and parallel to West 84" Street; and
South Martin Luther King Drive.
